# WhatsApp
> WhatsApp provides secure messaging, calling, groups, status, channels, and business communication across mobile and desktop devices.

WhatsApp is a global messaging platform used for personal and business communication, with product information on whatsapp.com, support on faq.whatsapp.com, business resources on business.whatsapp.com, and updates on blog.whatsapp.com.

## Core Product
- [Home](https://www.whatsapp.com/): Main product overview for WhatsApp messaging, calling, privacy, and platform features.
- [Download](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Download WhatsApp for mobile devices, desktop, and other supported platforms.
- [Messaging](https://www.whatsapp.com/messaging): Overview of private messaging features, media sharing, and communication tools.
- [Calling](https://www.whatsapp.com/calling): Overview of voice and video calling features across WhatsApp.
- [Groups](https://www.whatsapp.com/groups): Information about WhatsApp group conversations and group communication features.
- [Status](https://www.whatsapp.com/status): Overview of status sharing for photos, videos, and temporary updates.
- [Channels](https://www.whatsapp.com/channels): Information about channels for one-way updates from people and organizations.

## Privacy and Security
- [Security](https://www.whatsapp.com/security): Overview of WhatsApp security protections, encryption, and account safety features.
- [Privacy](https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy): Information about privacy controls, data practices, and user protections.
- [End-to-End Encryption](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/security-and-privacy/about-end-to-end-encryption): Help article explaining WhatsApp end-to-end encryption protections.
- [Two-Step Verification](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/account-and-profile/about-two-step-verification): Help article about enabling and managing two-step verification.
- [Safety and Security](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/security-and-privacy): Help Center section covering privacy, security, and account protection topics.

## Apps and Platform Support
- [Apps](https://whatsapp.com/download): Download page for WhatsApp applications across supported devices and operating systems.
- [WhatsApp Web](https://web.whatsapp.com/): Browser-based access to WhatsApp linked with a mobile account.
- [Desktop Download](https://www.whatsapp.com/download): Official desktop and device download options for WhatsApp.
- [Help Center](https://faq.whatsapp.com/): Official support portal for setup, troubleshooting, and feature guidance.
- [About Supported Operating Systems](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/download-and-installation/about-supported-operating-systems): Help article on device and operating system support requirements.

## Help Center
- [FAQ Home](https://faq.whatsapp.com/): Main entry point for WhatsApp support articles and troubleshooting resources.
- [Download and Installation](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/download-and-installation): Help topics for installing and updating WhatsApp.
- [Account and Profile](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/account-and-profile): Help topics for account setup, profile management, and verification.
- [Chats](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/chats): Help topics for messaging, media, and chat management.
- [Voice and Video Calls](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/voice-and-video-calls): Help topics for calling features and troubleshooting.
- [Communities and Groups](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/groups): Help topics for groups, communities, and participant management.
- [Channels](https://faq.whatsapp.com/general/channels): Help topics for using and managing WhatsApp channels.

## Business Platform
- [WhatsApp Business](https://business.whatsapp.com/): Overview of WhatsApp solutions for businesses and customer communication.
- [WhatsApp Business App](https://business.whatsapp.com/products/business-app): Information about the app for small business messaging.
- [WhatsApp Business Platform](https://business.whatsapp.com/products/platform): Information about the API-based platform for business messaging at scale.
- [Success Stories](https://business.whatsapp.com/resources/success-stories): Case studies showing how businesses use WhatsApp.
- [Resources](https://business.whatsapp.com/resources): Business guides, playbooks, and educational materials.
- [Developers](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp): Developer documentation for WhatsApp business integrations.

- [Channels](https://www.whatsapp.com/channels): Product overview for broadcast-style channel updates.

## Blog and Updates
